title: Video Diffusion Avatars: Taming Video Diffusion Models into Controllable 3D Avatars
title_zh: 视频扩散化身：将视频扩散模型驯化为可控3D化身

paragraphs.en: 该文提出VDAs方法，通过微调视频扩散模型从单张图像生成高保真、多视角一致且可控表情、姿态与视角的3D化身。 Video diffusion models (VDMs) trained on internet-scale data encode a rich prior on appearance, motion, and physics that is difficult to replicate with explicit 3D rendering and costly 3D data capture. We introduce Video Diffusion Avatars (VDAs), a method that creates photo-realistic, multi-view consistent avatars from a single image by fine-tuning a VDM for precise control over camera viewpoint, facial expression, and upper-body pose. Departing from 3D morphable models (3DMMs), VDAs use a learned expression space that lifts the expressiveness ceiling of 3DMMs, e.g., for the tongue and mouth interior. However, learned expression codes exhibit heavy viewpoint bias, as our DISTRACT benchmark reveals. We show that this bias can be removed through disentanglement, enabling their use as driving signals for multi-view consistent avatars. Camera and upper-body pose are controlled jointly via proxy-mesh renderings, giving independent control over expression, pose, and viewpoint. A camera-triplet training strategy makes the approach efficient: our models train for 34 hours on a single A100 using only public multi-view data. VDAs outperform state-of-the-art single-image 3D avatars on novel-view reenactment, reducing face LPIPS by 29% and improving perceptual quality (JOD) by 66% on BecomingLit. A static 3DGS reconstruction probe further confirms that our generations are the most multi-view consistent. Built on a video prior, VDAs produce effects beyond the reach of explicit renderers, including physically plausible hair dynamics, shadows, reflections, and refractions.
paragraphs.zh: 该文提出VDAs方法，通过微调视频扩散模型从单张图像生成高保真、多视角一致且可控表情、姿态与视角的3D化身。在互联网规模数据上训练的视频扩散模型（VDMs）编码了关于外观、运动和物理的丰富先验，这是显式3D渲染和高成本3D数据采集难以复现的。 我们提出视频扩散化身（VDAs），一种通过微调VDM实现对面部表情、上半身姿态和相机视角的精确控制，从而从单张图像创建照片级真实、多视角一致化身的方法。 不同于3D可变形模型（3DMMs），VDAs使用一个学习到的表情空间，提升了3DMMs的表现力上限，例如对舌头和口腔内部的表现。 然而，正如我们的DISTRACT基准所揭示的，学习到的表情编码存在严重的视角偏差。 我们证明这种偏差可以通过解耦消除，从而使其能够作为多视角一致化身的驱动信号。 相机和上半身姿态通过代理网格渲染进行联合控制，实现对表情、姿态和视角的独立控制。 相机三元组训练策略使该方法高效：我们的模型仅使用公开的多视角数据，在单个A100上训练34小时。 在新视角重演任务上，VDAs优于最先进的单图像3D化身，在BecomingLit上将人脸LPIPS降低29%，感知质量（JOD）提升66%。 静态3DGS重建探针进一步证实我们的生成结果具有最佳的多视角一致性。 基于视频先验，VDAs能够产生显式渲染器无法实现的效果，包括物理合理的头发动态、阴影、反射和折射。
